observation: Builder src/render/characters/morrowModel.js, dispatched by visualFactory.js:7991 (e.data.morrow). Seven finishes are built per instance (12-29) and all seven are used by the body/lids/field, so there is no unused finish to dispose at build time — unlike bracket, no used-set guard is needed here; teardown is explicit via disposeMorrowVisual (279-286) plus renderer traversal. Static rigid assemblies are baked with bakeRigid (59-78), which merges by material and disposes source geometry and stale buffers; the chassis (157), head shell (168), arm assemblies (192) and chime frames (204) are baked, while animated joints (head, six lids, two arms, chimes, gyro) remain separate. The rescue field and launch pulse are each an instance-local ShaderMaterial with per-instance uniforms (95-97, 212-219); that is deliberate because uTime/uEnergy/uPulse track this drone's state only, and the motion closure writes them per frame (253-267). No static materials are cloned per frame and no geometry is rebuilt during motion. Budget guarded by test/morrow-model.test.mjs (meshes<=42, tris<30000). No model-level LOD, consistent with the character set.
decision: Keep. No construction change recommended; finish usage is complete, rigid baking is in place, and per-instance shader uniforms are necessary. Recommend needs follow-up pending current captures.
next: Needs current gameplay-scale and close Morrow captures (rescue encounter and quiet/shy state) plus draw cost; static review cannot accept the visual.
